tasks.name: cron-dup-probe
tasks.prompt: Append one line to the file cron-log.txt in your workspace containing the current UTC timestamp and the word fired. Use a shell command like: date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ fired' >> cron-log.txt. Do nothing else and do not reply with anything besides confirming the line was appended.
